Components

Every part of the portal you can pick up and put on a page. Each preview runs on the production CSS and JS, and its code is one click away. For when and why to use something, see the Design System.

Paste

Copy the HTML into your page and load the files listed under Needs. If it is marked Inline CSS, paste its CSS tab into the page too.

Include

Shared chrome like the nav and footer. Never paste it. Add the PARTIAL marker, set the body classes, then run npm run build:partials. A pasted copy is overwritten on the next build.

Call

A function in a shared script. Load the script and call it. There is no markup to paste, and no second copy of the logic to write.

For AI tools

Read COMPONENTS.md, a small index. Pick one, then read only its source file. components.json holds everything in one file. Copy for AI on any component gives a ready brief.
